archetypes.name: dyn-wire-ratchets
archetypes.rationale: New wire-artifact and gh wrapper-bypass linters rely on baseline identity stability.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the new lint_wire_artifact_pairing implementation, the subprocess-via-runner gh extension, and their baselines. Focus on manifest and baseline validation, production-vs-test scan scope, stable identities, and whether warning/pass behavior matches the ratchet contract. Check that wrapper exemptions and inline suppressions cannot hide unrelated findings. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
